item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2891] Impossible to use jdbc interface with presto-jdbc >= 0.180
item.description:
Hello,

I have been trying since yesterday to integrate Presto (0.183) with Apache Zeppelin (0.7.2) (using the presto-jdbc driver interface), and, so far, I am hitting a roadblock.

Since presto version 0.180 and higher, with commit defabcba4e1b89d5df536da51258cfdbfea906cb ("Improve properties/URL parameter handling"), developers did tighten connection properties with com.facebook.presto.jdbc.PrestoDriverUri.validateConnectionProperties.
This function rejects anything that is not specified into com.facebook.presto.jdbc.ConnectionProperties.

Sadly, Zeppelin adds extra property keys such as "url" and "driver" which, naturally, get rejected. (See org.apache.zeppelin.jdbc.JDBCInterpreter.java at function "open")

Comes my question: which one shall get patched?

item.summary: Impossible to use jdbc interface with presto-jdbc >= 0.180

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
It has been quite a while since I made this issue and it didn't get any comment (except a person which forgot to set the default.user property and thought it was the right place to ask). The same applies to the presto google group thread.

Anyway, after re-reading the code for both projects, I would say that Zeppelin might be the one to patch. It is understandable, from the presto-jdbc point of view, not to accept a property list full of useless values. The fact that "url" and "driver" inadvertently get added in the properties is a bug to my eyes. I do not know a jdbc library requiring such duplicated properties either.

As a workaround, I did patch presto-jdbc to accept any kind of property thrown to it. It will just discard them and continue its regular execution.
Here's the patch which also happen to pass all unit tests: https://groups.google.com/group/presto-users/attach/1231343dbdd09/presto-jdbc.diff
I would prefer a patch in Zeppelin that ignores "default.url" and "default.driver" during parsing.

Have a nice day.
We intentionally added property validation to the Presto JDBC driver as this prevents mistakes due to typos, etc. Zeppelin needs to be changed to not pass invalid properties.

Finally some bits of activity here (I spotted yesterday the Github issue, and expected you to come here). I have elaborated a patch back in September, but never spent the time to test its integration (unit tests are fine though).

All the meat goes is into createConnectionPool which clones the Properties object and removes the driver and url fields before continuing with this new object. The rest of the code change is just fixing typos or rearranging the order of the parameters in the logger.
Just FYI, related discussion on Presto side https://github.com/prestodb/presto/issues/9254
